regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kind favor of the 5th. I hope you are feeling better by this time. It seems to me your apathy regarding glasses is uncalled for ..... As long as I can remember I was inclined to think that, in many cases, glasses quite improved the appearance of the wearer. I would not doubt this could easily apply to M.K. Thanks be to God I was surprized at looking at your letter today, I could read it nicely without glasses. I started to a Chiropractor in July - two treatments a week and I am feeling improved all round. My Dr. in Detroit who put me on my feet in one month - after trying M.Ds. for years - was Dr. R. N. Schon ( Chiropractor) of 10050 Connor Ave. - just across Gratiot from the Air Port. He positively helped quite a few patients I sent him - even when almost blind. If you go to him .... Best regards! .God bless you now and be grateful to God .... Don't worry . . ..
